source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 11.2.2, printed pages 247-249.

blocks.text: Branched chain (shakhon wale) alkanes ke naam neeche diye gaye rules ke mutabiq rakhe jate hain.

1. Carbon atoms ki sab se lambi continuous (bina toote) chain dhoondein; yahi chain alkane ka parent naam tay karti hai. Neeche wale pehle compound ko hexane kehte hain kyunke us ki sab se lambi chain mein chhe carbon atoms hain, chahe chain muri hui ho.
Formula jis tarah likha hota hai us se sab se lambi chain hamesha foran nazar nahi aati. Maslan doosra alkane heptane hai kyunke us ki sab se lambi chain mein saat carbon atoms hain (mor ke neeche wale do carbon bhi chain mein gine jate hain).

blocks.alt: Do condensed formulae; sab se lambi carbon zanjeer neeli shaded aur substituent CH3 gulabi daire mein. Pehla: seedhi chhe carbon zanjeer jis ke paanchwen carbon par CH3. Doosra: zanjeer CH par neeche mur kar CH2 aur CH3 tak jati hai, saat carbons, aur daire wala CH3 daen taraf.
blocks.caption: Usool 1 ki misalein: sab se lambi musalsal zanjeer (hexane aur heptane) (kitab ke safha 247 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har diagram mein neela shaded hissa parent (sab se lambi) chain hai aur gulabi daira substituent (chain se juri hui shaakh). Chain seedhi likhi ho ya muri hui, carbons ginte waqt mor ke saath chalein.
2. Sab se lambi chain ko us sire se number dein jo substituent ke sab se qareeb ho. Is rule se oopar wale dono alkanes ki numbering yun hogi.

blocks.alt: Wahi do compounds numbers ke saath. Mura hua heptane oopar 7, 6, 5, 4, 3 aur mor ke neeche 2, 1; daire wala CH3 carbon 3 par, teer us par 'Substituent' likhta hai. Hexane baen se daen 6 se 1; daire wala CH3 carbon 2 se latka hai, teer 'Substituent'.
blocks.caption: Usool 2 ki misalein: substituent ke qareeb wale sire se numbering (kitab ke safha 247 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: 3. Rule 2 se mile numbers se substituent group ki jagah batayein. Parent naam aakhir mein likha jata hai, aur substituent group us ki jagah ke number ke saath pehle likha jata hai. Maslan:

blocks.alt: Number shuda shaded zanjeerein naamon ke saath: carbon 3 par daire wale CH3 wali muri saat carbon zanjeer 3-methylheptane; carbon 2 par CH3 wali seedhi chhe carbon zanjeer 2-methylhexane.
blocks.caption: Usool 3 ki misalein: 3-methylheptane aur 2-methylhexane (kitab ke safha 248 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: 4. Jab do ya zyada substituents hon to har substituent ko sab se lambi chain par us ki jagah ka number dein. Maslan neeche wale compound ka naam 4-ethyl-2-methylhexane hai.

blocks.alt: Shaded zanjeer H3C-CH-CH2-CH-CH2-CH3, number 1 se 6. Carbon 2 se daire wala CH3 aur carbon 4 se daire wala CH2 jis se daire wala CH3 jura hai (ethyl group). Naam: 4-Ethyl-2-methylhexane.
blocks.caption: Usool 4 ki misal: 4-ethyl-2-methylhexane (kitab ke safha 248 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Substituent groups alphabetical order (A, B, C ki tarteeb) mein likhe jate hain, yani ethyl pehle aur methyl baad mein. Alphabetical order tay karte waqt “di” aur “tri” jaise multiplying prefixes (ginti batane wale shuru ke hisse) ko nahi gina jata.
5. Jab do substituents aik hi carbon atom par hon to us carbon ka number do baar likhein.

blocks.alt: Zanjeer H3C-CH2-C-CH2-CH2-CH3, number 1 se 6. Carbon 3 par oopar CH3 aur neeche CH2-CH3 (ethyl). Naam: 3-Ethyl-3-methylhexane.
blocks.caption: Usool 5 ki misal: 3-ethyl-3-methylhexane (kitab ke safha 248 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki rule 5 wali misal mein carbon 5 ‘CH’ chhapa hai. Wahan koi shaakh nahi, is liye sahi CH₂ hai, jaisa oopar diagram mein hai.
6. Jab do ya zyada substituents aik jaise hon to yeh di, tri, tetra waghaira prefixes se batayein. Phir yaqeeni banayein ke har aik substituent ka apna number likha ho.

blocks.alt: Teen condensed formulae. H3C-CH(CH3)-CH(CH3)-CH3, 2,3-Dimethylbutane. H3C-CH(CH3)-CH(CH3)-CH(CH3)-CH3, darmiyani CH3 oopar, 2,3,4-Trimethylpentane. H3C-C(CH3)2-C(CH3)2-CH3, har darmiyani carbon par oopar neeche methyl, 2,2,3,3-Tetramethylbutane.
blocks.caption: Usool 6 ki misalein: 2,3-dimethylbutane, 2,3,4-trimethylpentane aur 2,2,3,3-tetramethylbutane (kitab ke safha 248 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein doosre compound ka naam ‘2,3,4-trimethyl butane’ chhapa hai, magar us ki chain paanch carbon ki hai, is liye sahi naam 2,3,4-trimethylpentane hai. 2,2,3,3-tetramethylbutane ke aakhir mein aik faltu ‘CH’ chhapa hai. Dono oopar diagram mein sahi banaye gaye hain.
In chhe rules se hum zyada tar alkanes ke naam rakh sakte hain. Kabhi kabhi do aur rules ki zaroorat parti hai.
7. Jab barabar lambai ki do chains parent chain banne ke liye muqabla karein to woh chain chunein jis par zyada substituents hon.

blocks.alt: Zanjeer H3C-CH2-CH-CH-CH-CH-CH3, baen se daen 7 se 1. Carbons 5, 3 aur 2 se CH3, aur carbon 4 se propyl zanjeer CH2-CH2-CH3. Naam: 2,3,5-Trimethyl-4-propylheptane.
blocks.caption: Usool 7 ki misal: 2,3,5-trimethyl-4-propylheptane (kitab ke safha 249 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki rule 7 wali misal mein carbons 5 aur 4 ‘CH₂’ chhape hain aur propyl group CH₃–CH₂–CH₃ likha hai. Sahi yeh hai: carbon 5 CH hai (us par CH₃ hai) aur propyl group –CH₂–CH₂–CH₃ hai, jaisa oopar diagram mein hai.
8. Jab shaakh sab se lambi chain ke dono siron se barabar faasle par shuru ho to woh naam chunein jo pehle farq wali jagah par chhota number de.

blocks.alt: Zanjeer CH3-CH-CH2-CH-CH-CH3, baen se daen 6 se 1, carbons 5, 3 aur 2 par CH3. Naam: 2,3,5-Trimethylhexane (2,4,5-trimethylhexane nahi).
blocks.caption: Usool 8 ki misal: 2,3,5-trimethylhexane (kitab ke safha 249 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki rule 8 wali misal mein carbon 6 aur carbon 5 ‘CH₂’ chhape hain. Sahi yeh hai: carbon 6 CH₃ hai aur carbon 5 CH hai (neeche CH₃ ke saath), jaisa oopar diagram mein hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Rule 8 ki misal mein aik taraf se numbers 2, 3, 5 aate hain aur doosri taraf se 2, 4, 5. Pehla number (2) dono mein barabar hai; doosre number par pehla farq aata hai, aur 3 chhota hai 4 se. Is liye naam 2,3,5-trimethylhexane hai.

blocks.caption: Rules lagana
rows: chhe carbon ki chain, C2 par CH₃
chhe carbon ki chain, C4 par C₂H₅ aur C2 par CH₃
propane ke C2 par do CH₃

blocks.explanation: Is compound ki sab se lambi chain paanch carbon ki hai. Aik sire se number dein to methyl groups carbons 2, 2 aur 4 par aate hain; doosre sire se 2, 4 aur 4 par. Pehle farq wali jagah (doosra number) par 2 chhota hai 4 se, is liye naam 2,2,4-trimethylpentane hai.

items: Sab se lambi chain = parent; substituent ke qareeb wale sire se number; substituent number ke saath pehle, alphabetical order mein (di, tri nahi gine jate); aik hi carbon par do: number do baar; aik jaise groups: di, tri, tetra; barabar chains: zyada substituents wali; barabar faasla: pehle farq par chhota number.
